revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_012
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 12, ORANGE rank, SECOND medal in the orange pair. Based on the Chinese title concept "踏破铁鞋无觅处，蓦然回首，那人却在灯火阑珊处" (worn-through iron shoes and a lantern-lit discovery). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot style: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 12 pose: the foot mascot wears or holds a comically battered tiny iron shoe sole, looking surprised and delighted under warm lantern glow, with little lantern-like light orbs and a winding stone path, but no text or symbols.
Medal border: ORANGE rank, SECOND orange medal. Use a refined orange and amber enamel circular border with silver trim, orange gems, elegant top crest, and clearly visible symmetrical orange side wings / flame-feather orange-silver wings extending outward from the circle. This must be more ornate than tier 11 and obviously the upgraded second medal of the orange pair. Avoid gold dominance; keep it orange rank.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals and previous anthropomorphic foot candidates: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central foot mascot fully inside circular core, side wings visible but inside safe margins.
Lighting/mood: bright warm highlights, surprised and funny, lantern-like glow.
Color palette: orange and amber border, silver trim, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, warm lantern light, muted gray iron shoe; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: include orange side wings, include flame-feather orange-silver wings, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold; second medal of each color pair has wings
wing_rule: second medal in color pair has wings
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
